Data Visualization II

JF

2026-10-11

library(readr)
Bird_data <- read_csv("Bird_data.csv")
## Rows: 60 Columns: 9
## ── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Delimiter: ","
## chr  (4): Location, Variable, Nest (Y/N), Observation Date
## dbl  (4): Bag mass(g), mass_withbag(g), mass, Bird ID
## time (1): Entry Time
## 
## ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
## ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(Bird_data, aes(x=Location, y=`Bird ID`)) + 
  geom_point(size=8, color="gold", fill="maroon", shape=23)

geom_point(aes(y=`Nest (Y/N)`),size=4)
## mapping: y = ~`Nest (Y/N)` 
## geom_point: na.rm = FALSE
## stat_identity: na.rm = FALSE
## position_identity
ggplot(Bird_data, aes(x=`Observation Date`, y=`Entry Time`)) + 
  geom_point(size=5, color="navy", fill="maroon", shape=20)

geom_point(aes(y=`Nest (Y/N)`),size=4)
## mapping: y = ~`Nest (Y/N)` 
## geom_point: na.rm = FALSE
## stat_identity: na.rm = FALSE
## position_identity
plot(Bird_data$`Bag mass(g)`~ Bird_data$`Bird ID`)

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(Bird_data, aes(x = Variable, y = `Entry Time`)) + 
  geom_dotplot(
    binaxis = "y", 
    stackdir = "center", 
    alpha = 0.9,         # Makes the dots slightly transparent
    color = "gold",      # Outline color of the dots
    fill = "maroon"      # Inside color of the dots
  )
## Bin width defaults to 1/30 of the range of the data. Pick better value with
## `binwidth`.

ggplot(Bird_data, aes(x = `Entry Time`, y = `Bird ID`)) + 
  geom_point(color = "maroon", size = 3) +  # Standard scatter plot points
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm", 
    color = "gold",        # Golden trend line
    fill = "gold",         # Golden confidence interval ribbon
    alpha = 0.15,          # Light transparency for the ribbon
    linewidth = 1.2,       # Distinct line thickness
    linetype = "solid"     # Solid line type
  )
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'
